project: Specialty Coffee Shop Unit (walk-up window), Al-Jubeiha, Amman - PRUDENT scenario (risk-analyst) - funding S2b_reserve_bank_12pct
_note: Every number carries a source or 'ASSUMPTION: reason'. Prices exclude GST: marketing prices are GST-inclusive (16%, 04-legal) and are divided by 1.16 here.

capex.name: Key money (khilw)
capex.source: 07-risk: OpenSooq Amman listings Oct 2026, khilw JOD 5,000 (Umm Al-Summaq) and 6,900 (Majdi Mall booth, University St); lower end used, amortised over 5-yr lease ASSUMPTION

pre_opening_costs.name: Rent during fit-out and licensing (4 months x 550)
pre_opening_costs.source: ASSUMPTION: lease signed month 1, opening month 5 (03-operations 3.7); rent 550/month (03-operations [R5][R6]). Paid inside the first 6-month advance; the other 2 advance months cover operating months 1-2, already charged in fixed opex

pre_opening_costs.name: Pre-opening staff hiring and training
pre_opening_costs.source: ASSUMPTION: head barista 1.5 months + barista 0.5 month before opening (03-operations 3.7) at gross 500/380 x 1.1425 employer SS

pre_opening_costs.name: Opening inventory (beans, milk, cups, pastries) and dial-in
pre_opening_costs.source: ASSUMPTION: about 2 weeks of month-1 cost of goods

revenue_streams.name: Coffee drinks
revenue_streams.unit_cost_source: 03-operations 3.5: weighted COGS per drink incl. packaging and 5% waste
revenue_streams.volume_source: 05-marketing section 5 ramp (built on 01-market SOM 117/163/210 drinks/day); units_year[0] ignored by the model

_price_growth_source: ASSUMPTION: menu prices raised ~2%/yr, slightly below CPI (DoS 2.26% Jan-Sep 2026); marketing held prices flat and invited indexation
_channel_commission_source: Delivery: 15% of sales via Talabat/Careem x 25% all-in commission = 3.75% of revenue (05-marketing). Card fees: ASSUMPTION 60% of walk-up (85%) sales paid by card at 1.5% MDR = 0.77%; Jordan bank MDRs not published (Jordan Islamic Bank POS page gives no figure); Careem payment processing 1.5-3% (Menuviel 2026) as context. Total 4.52%, rounded to 4.5%

fixed_opex_monthly.name: Annual licence renewals and health certificates (monthly accrual)
fixed_opex_monthly.source: ASSUMPTION: ~JOD 360/yr; 04-legal says renewal fees exist but amounts not retrievable

_fixed_opex_note: Operations' JOD 150/month local marketing line is excluded here because the marketing section's budget (separate marketing input) already covers ads, sampling and influencers.
opex_inflation_source: Jordan DoS via QNA 12 Oct 2026: CPI +2.26% Jan-Sep 2026 y/y, +2.73% Sept y/y; 2.5% used (midpoint)

payroll.source: 03-operations 3.4 ASSUMPTION: owner works unpaid; see owner-salary scenario

employer_contribution_source: 04-legal (PwC/Payoneer). Salaries above are GROSS (operations' 1,005/1,211/1,440 totals already include SS), so SS is applied once here

marketing.source: 05-marketing: year-1 JOD 7,890 (3x980 + 9x550) = 658/month average; 3% of revenue from year 2

discount_rate_source: CBJ main policy rate 5.75% (held 30 Jul 2026, Jordan News) + ASSUMPTION 10% premium for a small, unlisted, first-time owner food business = 15.75%, rounded to 16%. Cross-check: Jordan bank lending rate 8.24% (CEIC, Jan 2025); equity in a startup should require well above that
